name: Bitter Woman
overview: Scripture warns against the destructive nature of bitterness, urging believers to put away all bitterness, wrath, and anger as seen in Ephesians 4:31. The root of bitterness can cause spiritual defilement and hinder grace, as Hebrews 12:15 cautions. Instead, Christians are called to kindness, tenderheartedness, and forgiveness, reflecting God's forgiveness through Christ (Ephesians 4:32). Within marriage, the Bible emphasizes mutual love and respect, with wives encouraged to reverence their husbands, promoting harmony rather than bitterness (Ephesians 5:33). The example of King Lemuel’s mother teaching wisdom (Proverbs 31:1) further highlights the importance of godly instruction to guard against bitterness.
